# Document review

Reviewers and agents cooperate through explicit review rounds.

## Comments

Write a precise instruction before sending the batch to an agent, including the expected behavior and enough context to locate the relevant change.

Text size controls the document reading column and is independent of the navigation tree and the comment feed.

The preference stays on this device and does not change the project documents or another reader's display settings.

## Change markers

Changes remain unread until the reviewer confirms the displayed version.

Every visible change has both a semantic label and a line marker.

## Working on another device

The document stays readable while its review state loads.

Changes are matched by block identity rather than by display position.

- Keep the last complete view while reconnecting.
- Preserve the current reading position.
- Explain a missing machine without substituting another host.

A newly added paragraph explains how a reviewer can undo a read receipt without rewriting any later independent confirmation.
